load_wav_audio_samples: load WAV audio samples from binary data and return an ArrayInterface object for NumPy consumption
load_wav_with_time_offset: load WAV audio samples starting from a specific time offset in seconds from binary data
load_wav_with_duration: load WAV audio samples for a specific duration in seconds from binary WAV data
parse_wav_header: parse WAV file header from binary data and extract metadata into a WAVHeader object
review_WAVArrayInterface_class: review the _WAVArrayInterface class that wraps C++ array interface data for NumPy compatibility
